query:
SELECT
    signal.id,
    signal.organization_id,
    signal.account_id,
    signal.data_type AS "data_type: AccountResearchChunkDataType",
    signal.topic_tags AS "topic_tags!: Vec<String>",
    signal.source_type AS "source_type: AccountResearchChunkSourceType",
    signal.source_reference,
    signal.chunk_topic,
    signal.confidence,
    signal.content AS "content!: JsonValue",
    signal.version,
    signal.superseded_by,
    signal.input_chunk_ids AS "input_chunk_ids?: Vec<Uuid>",
    signal.prompt_id,
    signal.prompt_version,
    signal.retrieval_query AS "retrieval_query: JsonValue",
    signal.model_id,
    signal.generated_at,
    signal.created_at,
    signal.updated_at
FROM account_signal_feed_items feed
INNER JOIN account_research_chunks signal
    ON signal.id = feed.signal_chunk_id
   AND signal.superseded_by IS NULL
INNER JOIN account_research_chunks card
    ON card.id = feed.card_chunk_id
   AND card.organization_id = feed.organization_id
   AND card.account_id = feed.account_id
   AND card.source_chunk_id = feed.signal_chunk_id
   AND card.data_type = 'DERIVED_OUTPUT'::account_research_chunk_data_type
   AND card.derived_output_key = 'signalCard'
   AND card.superseded_by IS NULL
WHERE feed.organization_id = $1
  AND feed.account_id = $2
  AND feed.is_ready_displayable = TRUE
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR feed.display_bucket = $3)
  AND ($4::text IS NULL OR feed.signal_type = $4)
ORDER BY
  feed.published_at_date DESC NULLS LAST,
  feed.created_at DESC,
  feed.signal_chunk_id DESC
LIMIT $5
OFFSET $6
